name: fld_mul_isSquare_of_not_isSquare
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (a b : K) (ha : ¬ IsSquare a) (hb : ¬ IsSquare b) : IsSquare (a * b)
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (a b : K) (ha : ¬ IsSquare a) (hb : ¬ IsSquare b), IsSquare (a * b)
informal: In a finite field the product of two non-squares is a square — in characteristic 2 everything is a square; otherwise the quadratic character is multiplicative with values ±1 on nonzero elements and equals -1 exactly on non-squares (quadraticChar_neg_one_iff_not_isSquare), so χ(ab) = 1.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [Fintype K] (a b : K), ¬IsSquare a → ¬IsSquare b → IsSquare (a * b)
